North East Region

North East

A newer administrative region with old routes, dramatic landforms and markets that connect communities across the north.

An old earth-built church at Nalerigu · Photo: Shahadusadik

Capital

Nalerigu

Go for

Escarpments, markets and old trading routes

Good to know

North East became a region in 2019.

Festivals in
North East.

Festivals and cultural events kept here, in calendar order. Many dates move from year to year, so each festival’s page has what we know about when.

  • Lunar

    Damba in Nalerigu

    Mamprugu’s great gathering: chiefs from across the kingdom, dances through the night and the Nayiri at sunrise.

    The lunar month of Damba (about late August in 2026); the Mamprusi calendar sets the dayThe Nayiri’s palace, Nalerigu
